title: DIRECT. XVI. Let your life on Earth be a conversation in Heaven; by the constant work ofGr. Dir. 16. Faith and Love: even such a faith as maketh things future as now present, and the unseen world as i

segments.text: MY Treatise of The Life of Faith, and the fourth Part of The Saints Rest being written wholly or mostly to this use, I must refer the Reader to them, and say no more of it in this Direction.
